notes.title: Yuri Bundle Update
notes.content:
The Hanako Yuri Bundle has now been updated, allowing for a discount on [b]Black Closet[/b] as well as other yuri-focused titles.

Our latest edition, [b]Night Cascades[/b], features two adult heroines who are forced to work together to solve a series of occult crimes. While this is a visual novel and not a gameplay-heavy title like [b]Black Closet[/b], it does have some puzzle minigames and it should appeal to anyone who enjoys the darker graphics and mysterious tone of [b]Black Closet[/b], as well as more-serious lesbian relationships.

Visit the bundle collection here:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1085/Hanako_Yuri_Bundle/

notes.title: Look out for extra-spooky cases on Oct 31!
notes.content:
Remember, if you play Black Closet on October 31 (or April 1st) there are a few bonus case types that can trigger which may not behave like normal cases. Do not be alarmed! Everything will go back to normal once Halloween is over.

But if you've never seen the spooky cases, launch the game on Halloween and see if you can find anything [i]weird[/i] lurking in the halls of St. Claudine's....

(It's only a couple of case types and they're randomly generated, so they may or may not occur for you.)

Thais Halloween artwork courtesy of [url=https://www.deviantart.com/saitoikiru/art/Com-4-Hanako-Games-569398266]Saito Ikiru[/url]

notes.title: Happy Halloween!
notes.content:
While most mysteries in [i][b]Black Closet[/b][/i] have perfectly ordinary explanations, on Halloween it is possible for mysteries to be generated that are a bit more eldritch than usual, and may lead to CERTAIN DOOM.

Do not be alarmed! The school will return to normal once Halloween has passed.

Have fun!

notes.title: Black Closet Dev Releases A Little Lily Princess
notes.content:
A childhood in the hands of Hanako Games can be filled with love and joy, but is always perilous. Long Live the Queen can make decisions like avoiding PE class into deadly mistakes, and procedural detective procedural Black Closet exposes teens to something far more vicious – a private girls’ school. Hanako’s latest, A Little Lily Princess [official site], sends a spoiled girl to boarding school and maybe this time it’s fine. You can make friends and study and whatnot, and that sounds good, doesn’t it?

I’m sure this picture of a scullery maid hanging from a roof simply shows a jovial prank.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Feature Update (May 2016)
notes.content:
A new patch has been pushed out with a handful of changes.

The menu should now make it more obvious that "Save and Quit" is an option, if you need to save mid-week.

A bug preventing the scene where [spoiler]Althea[/spoiler] pulls out of the council has been corrected. The scene has also been updated so that you can make her return skill-training points that have been spent on her, and adds a hint that you should be focusing your training on your most loyal minions.

Some minor crash bugs have been fixed.

More detail on the most recent update can be found in this thread:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/400580/discussions/0/361787186421906510/

Please use that thread to report any problems.

Thanks!

notes.title: Have You Played Black Closet?
notes.content:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game recommendations. One a day, every day of the year, perhaps for all time.

Black Closet [official site] is set in an girls boarding school, in which you play as a class president with an unlikely amount of power to interrogate, search and apprehend fellow students who pose a threat to the reputation of your school. But whether that setting appeals or not hardly matters: it is a procedural detective game better than any other.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: 1.2.16 update in beta
notes.content:
A handful of stability fixes and a change to one case to make it easier to solve are currently available on the beta branch.
 
We're also trying to get CG unlocks to sync properly across the cloud. If you're playing the game in multiple locations, please let us know if the new version is working better for you.

Forum discussion thread for the patch, including full changelog: 

http://steamcommunity.com/app/400580/discussions/0/517142892053921594/

To access the beta:
Right-click on the game in your steam library and select Properties. That should bring up a box with various options tabs, one of which says 'Betas'. On that tab, you'll see a dropdown with a list of options you can choose from - select "beta" and it should patch up to the new test content.
